Usage: ocfl ls [flags]

List objects in a storage root or files in an object

Flags:
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --root=STRING      The prefix/directory of the OCFL storage root used for
                         the command ($OCFL_ROOT)
      --debug            enable debug log messages

  -i, --id=STRING        The ID of an object in the storage root
      --object=STRING    full path to object root. If set, --root and --id are
                         ignored.
  -v, --version=0        The object version number (unpadded) to list contents
                         from. The default (0) lists the latest version.
  -d, --digests          Show digests when listing contents of an object
                         version.
